subject: POC timeline & success criteria - Aurora Systems (next steps)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC timeline & success criteria - Aurora Systems (next steps)

Hi Alex / Sana 

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery + proposed next steps to get the POC moving: helpful if you can confirm and reply with any edits.

High-level success criteria (as discussed)
- Integration: Redwood inference integrated with a subset of Aurora's document store; end-to-end inference calls working in staging.
- Latency: 95th percentile inference latency under 300ms for typical 256-token requests.
- Cost: Demonstrate a cost-per-inference profile that meets your internal target (approx < $0.02 per 1k tokens) during the trial with suggested batching settings.
- Quality: Model responses match your 10 example prompts with > 85% acceptance rate from product reviewers.

POC scope & evaluation plan
- Duration: 3 weeks of active evaluation (kickoff -> weekly check-ins -> final readout).
- Owners: Marissa (Redwood)  program coordination & success criteria; Dev (Redwood)  technical onboarding and infra; Alex (Aurora)  product owner; Sana (Aurora)  evaluation lead.
- Weekly cadence: 30-min standups each Friday to review logs, metrics, and blockers.
- Final readout: 45-min demo + review of metrics and next steps.

Proposed timeline (initial)
- Week 0 (Apr 26): Kickoff + infra access + data onboarding checklist.
- Week 1 (May 3): Baseline runs + latency/cost profile.
- Week 2 (May 10): Model tuning + regression tests.
- Week 3 (May 17): Final readout and decision meeting.

Attachments: Aurora-POC-plan-v1.pdf (initial plan), RACI-template.xlsx
Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cAuroraPOC

Immediate asks
1) Please confirm the success criteria above or suggest edits.
2) Confirm who on your infra side will provide AWS account/role or test cluster access (we'll need an IAM role or connection details).
3) Do the proposed dates look feasible? If you prefer a compressed timeline, let us know and we can adjust.

Happy to hop on a short call if that's easier.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

---

- Criteria: Looks good overall. We want to tighten the timeline if possible  can we aim for a 2-week active evaluation (kickoff Apr 26 -> final readout May 10)? Our execs want a faster turnaround.
- Stakeholders: I'll be the product owner and Sana will lead evaluation. I'll also loop in Miguel (infra) for AWS access  Miguel's email is miguel.rivas@aurora-systems.com (he can join the technical kickoff).

Alex  thanks for the quick reply and for looping Miguel. We can compress to a 2-week focused evaluation with the following adjustments:

Compressed 2-week plan (recommended)
- Kickoff (Apr 26): Technical onboarding, role provisioning, baseline dataset upload.
- Week 1 (Apr 27 - May 3): Baseline runs, basic tuning, data sampling. Deliverable: baseline latency/cost report.
- Week 2 (May 4 - May 10): Focused tuning on the 10 acceptance prompts, final regression checks, and prep for readout (May 10).

Tradeoffs/notes
- Tighter timeline reduces time for extended model tuning; we recommend focusing on the highest-priority 10 prompts you provided.
- We'll use default batching + caching profile to speed validation; if later needed, we can re-run longer tests.

Owners & cadence
- Redwood: Marissa (program lead), Dev (technical lead)  Dev will run the infra onboarding and help with any integration code.
- Aurora: Alex (product), Sana (evaluation lead), Miguel (infra).
- Weekly check-ins: short Friday syncs are replaced by two mid-week checkpoint calls (end of Week 1 and final readout), plus a quick async status update mid-week.

Next steps/asks from Aurora
1) Provide Miguel's contact so Dev can coordinate AWS role.
2) Share a sample of the 10 evaluation prompts (if you haven't already).
3) Confirm kickoff time on Apr 26  I'm proposing 14:00 PT (we've blocked 45 mins).

I've updated the plan and attached Aurora-POC-plan-v2.pdf with the compressed timeline. Also added a brief RACI in the drive link.
